tasks.title: Notify accepts database-only configuration and durable format-5 state safely
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, configuration/reference validation and ledger-format files plus corresponding Checks; Decisions 11-12 and durable ledger parts of 13-14; R1 database definitions and resend outcomes; Counterexamples (References and durable Resend); Security impact (local references/atomic writes). Pin merged contract 2.4.0. Allow optional/empty file only with service token; add token/file, polling and secret-dir settings; keep old file-only mode. File webhook accepts exactly one literal url/urlEnv/urlFile while DB definitions require contract refs. In remote-channels implement per-channel validation/resolution with notify-local env prefix and basename/realpath confinement, no literal DB url/file transport. Migrate ledger 4->5 preserving older supported migration paths and all entries; persist reference-only remote definitions and durable command rows. Implement atomic first-command admission plus failed->pending, id dedup, terminal settlement updating admitted rows in the SAME ledger transaction, postedState tracking and safe 7-day prune here with unit tests. T2 consumes remote storage, T3 consumes command storage; no external polls in this task. Offline CLI uses format 5, still exit 2 under lock; docs/AGENTS state format 5 and unsupported downgrade.

acceptance.command: bun test test/config.test.ts test/remote-channels.test.ts test/ledger.v5.test.ts test/ledger.test.ts test/index.test.ts test/failed-cli.test.ts test/webhook.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. With token, missing file/empty channels start; without token missing/empty file exits 2. Both token sources or unreadable/empty token file exit 2 without token value; trimmed-empty token-file env is unset. File webhook exactly-one url/ref enforced; DB PULSE_API_TOKEN, literal url, file transport, ../api/token, a/b, . and escaping symlink are refused; file ref without secret dir reports 'secret files are not enabled'. Format 4->5 preserves every entry, delivered/refused SMTP recipients and supported legacy loads; older notify refuses v5. Remote definitions retain 0 resolved secret values. Command row and failed->pending roll back together on failure; repeat id never re-executes; terminal settle updates admitted rows atomically. Prune keeps every unposted/open row and removes only posted finished rows older than 7 days. Offline failed CLI remains usable and lock refusal exits 2.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

tasks.title: Notify reconciles live channels without duplicate ownership or historical floods
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, live reload/reconcile/report/metrics behavior and matching Checks; Decisions 2, 5-6, 11-13; R1 report views/trimming; Counterexamples (whole channel, report sizes, references). Extend T1 with 15000-ms channel polling, fixed 5000-ms timeout/1048576-byte service-answer bound independent of feed limit, ETag/304, byte-hash local-file rereads, last-good DB persistence/cold restore, and 404 empty DB/log once. Public feeds keep no token; service calls alone use Bearer, redirect manual. Keep the complete worker handoff algorithm here: unchanged definition+secret digest kept, changed worker stops new work and finishes/times out in-flight work, waiting/pending keys move to one new owner; remove keeps pending, re-add resumes without reseed, wider routing seeds quietly, type changes retain recipient progress used only by email. Slow channel must not block others or polling. Install metric series dynamically; produce sanitized report after attempts and at least each 60000 ms with whole-id shadowing, rejected/failed lists and R1 size trimming. Stop loops before closing ledger. Tests of delivery/routing belong here; T3 adds live command polling.

acceptance.command: bun test test/remote-channels.test.ts test/channel-set.test.ts test/reconcile.test.ts test/index.test.ts test/routing-change.test.ts test/delivery.test.ts test/metrics.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Zero-channel DB-only process installs next-poll webhook, sends exactly 1 new matching incident and 0 historical incidents. Each checks/excludeChecks/components/excludeComponents/alerts/sendIncidents/remindEverySeconds field has matching and nonmatching live-change cases; widening sends 0 backlog events. File ops wholly shadows DB ops and only file receiver is hit; live removal unshadows DB ops. Destination change hands a pending retry to new receiver exactly once with 0 double-owned keys. Removal sends 0, re-add sends 1 without reseeding; unchanged definition+secret digest retains worker, secret rotation replaces it, type change preserves recipient progress. Slow worker does not block another worker or 15000-ms poll; newly installed channel metrics exist.

acceptance.command: bun test test/remote-channels.test.ts test/service-report.test.ts test/reconcile.test.ts test/index.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Polls use 5000-ms timeout, ETag/304 and service-only Bearer; feed calls carry 0 authorization headers. Invalid JSON/wire, >1048576-byte answer, timeout or bad local file retains last good and next good poll recovers; 304 still rereads file, 404 empties DB/logs once, tokenless mode makes 0 service calls, API-down cold start restores references from ledger. Missing/empty/unreadable secret retains last good version with rejection. Reports at apply attempts and <=60000-ms heartbeat include all shadowedIds even beyond first 200 file views; views hold no routing/payload/destination. 201+ file/failed entries retain literal totals; long file ids truncate to 199 chars+ellipsis and long failed ids are omitted/count toward total. Escaped report trims failed then fileChannels to <=524288 bytes. Sentinel resolved secret appears 0 times in report/log/metric.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

tasks.title: Live resend survives lost acknowledgements and sends one additional delivery
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, live resend/claim/result wiring, remaining Checks and Completion evidence; Decision 14 complete notify-side command protocol; R1/R2 claim/result shapes; Counterexamples (Resend); Security impact; Performance impact (notify); Acceptance evidence 2-4 and 7. Use T1 atomic ledger command/admission/settlement and T2 installed workers. Poll claims every 5000 ms and enqueue admitted pending payloads after transaction commit. Known command id only posts stored state; never rerun resend. Post oldest 20 unacknowledged states per poll, persist postedState on 204/404/409, log command/state once for refusals; retry timeout/network/5xx. Admission/final response loss, requeue and crash after commit must recover without another admission or send. Cover delivered/failed/dropped/not-failed/no-payload/channel-unavailable, unchanged idempotency-key/Message-ID and refused SMTP recipients only. Finish shutdown, CLI regression, docs, full/security/performance/manual evidence.

acceptance.command: bun test test/resend-commands.test.ts test/ledger.v5.test.ts test/ledger.test.ts test/index.test.ts test/failed-cli.test.ts test/email-smtp.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may fail its global threshold. Claim failed payload key -> admitted -> delivered, exactly 1 extra receiver request with the same idempotency-key. Repeat id after reopen or re-failure sends 0 additional requests and posts stored state. Lost admission and 60000-ms requeue, lost final response, final replay from queued/claimed and crash between commit/enqueue recover with 1 send; same-state and late admitted acknowledgements accept 204. 404/409 stop reposting with 1 sanitized log; timeout/network/5xx retries; at most 20 oldest pending results per poll. Channel a resend leaves channel b failed; delivered -> not-failed, no payload -> no-payload, absent channel -> channel-unavailable; stale reminder ends dropped. Partial SMTP retries only refused recipients, 0 repeats to delivered recipients, same Message-ID. All loops stop before ledger close; offline CLI works on format 5 and exits 2 while locked.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

PR includes check output, new tests failing on c79f0b7 then passing, applicable Security impact checklist (scope/bearer boundaries, 1-MiB answers, prefix/directory/symlink rules, report trimming, sentinels, transactions, redirect manual, pins), and downgrade/CLI limitations. Manual bun run start with local API/notify token/fake receiver shows DB channel install and failed resend without restart and exactly 1 extra hit. Read shared API harness finding; paste Performance impact notify A/B command with full SHAs and --b-ref notify=<branch>, rounds, loops on B, table/budget outcomes; explicitly report test_cpu_s against 3.4-s budget and any FAIL budget for owner decision without changing budgets. Include non-gating timing of format-4 ledger with 10000 entries opened as format 5.
